newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Normandy wants Exxon stake in j/v mine.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Normandy wants Exxon stake in j/v mine.

text.p: Normandy Mining Ltd said on Tuesday it would clearly be interested in buying U.S. oil giant Exxon Corp's 35 percent stake in the Golden Grove zinc and copper project in Western Australia.
"Clearly we would be an interested acquirer of that minority stake and we do have pre-emptive rights," Normandy general manager corporate affairs, Colin Jackson, told Reuters.
Normandy already owns 65 percent of the project and operates the Scuddles zinc and copper mine, while a copper feasibility study is being carried out at nearby Gossan Hill.
Jackson said he expected Normandy's majority ownership and management position at Golden Grove would "probably limit the number of potential buyers" of the Exxon stake.
Exxon on Monday said its affiliate Exxon Coal and Mineral Australia Ltd would consider purchase offers for its Australian coal and mineral assets.
Jackson said Normandy was not interested in any of Exxon's coal assets.
"I think to be in the coal business, you have got to be seriously big in coal, you cannot be a bit player," he said.
